title: Tycoons.gg
description: A Minecraft Tycoon-oriented Server with Prisons!
body:
💰 Welcome to **Tycoons.gg** 💰

We're a brand new Minecraft Server focused on Tycoon oriented Game Modes such as Prisons. Jump in, and get started making in-game money, and dominate the competition.

⛏️ **Mine, Upgrade, Advance.**
Create your team, and enter the mine. Advance through over 25+ mines, all the while upgrading your pickaxe, boosters, and more!

🚀 **Join Tycoons.gg**
